name: The Creative Lens

channels.note: Colden 2026-10-02 (CWC_PodReels Q1/Q9): 10 shorts per episode, "not all will go to both channels"; one tap on the edit preview approves it AND picks the destination.

name_cards: Colden 2026-10-01: only a GUEST gets a name tag. Colden and Jake: no. Colden and Todd (their show): no. Todd as a guest on The Creative Lens: yes. Guests = people the PodCut manifest marks host: false.

gaze.note: Colden 2026-10-02: covers need the speaker smiling at camera or looking forward - "Jake does not look directly at camera" (his camera is off-axis): Jake is judged against his OWN usual head pose, everyone else against the lens.

resolve.note: one vertical template per project; Colden puts his Fairlight strip on its A1 "Main Pod Audio" (ruling 8)

tcl.mcp: metricool-tcl (user-scope HTTP server, OAuth as The Creative Lens login)

metricool.playlist_field: youtubeData.playlistId is NOT accepted by the MCP connector (create and update both drop it, verified 2026-09-13 with post 375270732); posts created in the web app carry it. Set the playlist in the Metricool planner (Add to playlist) or YouTube Studio after publish.

gdrive.note: rclone remote uses the shared client_id (retiring 2026) — make an own client_id when it breaks
gdrive.note_media: Metricool has no Drive linked (Colden 2026-09-13): use uc?export=download direct links (files < 100 MB, no virus-scan interstitial); Metricool copies the media into its own hosting at scheduling.

ig_collaborators.note: guest is invited as IG collaborator on the Create with Colden post only, never on The Creative Lens (Colden 2026-09-13)
ig_collaborators.nick_note: Nick Williams (WillCo Media) - confirmed by Colden 2026-10-02

cadence.post_window: Friday through Thursday (7 days); the next round starts the following Friday
cadence.extras: shorts beyond one per day post as a second post on the busiest days, >= 3 h apart
cadence.applies_to: both CWC and TCL posts of Creative Lens shorts
cadence.best_times: Metricool getBestTimeToPostByNetwork with socialNetwork=tiktok, per brand (Colden 2026-09-13)
cadence.note: Ep 23 (Sep 15-26) was approved as a one-off spread

month_cap.note: Metricool posts per brand per calendar month - Colden 2026-10-02: Create with Colden 20; The Creative Lens 20 (Metricool plan).

caption_merges_note: Whisper spells model numbers as words; captions show the product name (2026-10-02: "FX three" read wrong on the pilot). Matched on consecutive words, case-insensitive.
